newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary milling wheat futures fall, maize mixed.
newsitem.headline: Hungary milling wheat futures fall, maize mixed.

text.p: Milling wheat futures prices on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) dropped for almost all maturities on Tuesday, the bourse said.
August, October and December milling wheat futures went limit-down, easing 400 forints and closing at 24,300, 25,800 and 26,600 forints respectively.
Only the closest milling wheat maturity, May, firmed on Tuesday. Its price was settled at 27,560 forints, up by 760.
Maize futures closed mixed. The May maturity eased by 300 forints to 18,700 while July maize rose by 100 forints to 18,800 and the November maturity ended at 20,120 forints, up 20.
Total grains futures turnover on the BCE rose to 1.09 billion forints on Tuesday from 669.7 million forints on Monday.
